root_cause: Return intent used ComponentId alone. Replacement/remount could receive stale focus; disabled-at-open intent could become valid later. Native consumer inferred model openness from restored focus.
shared_fix: ContentHost captures eligible (ComponentId, existing Content.mount), verifies original mount on close; existing focus path checks current eligibility.
applicable: All ContentHost modal DialogContent callers, including rich dialog consumer.
exceptions: Reorder preserves mount and restores focus. Replacement/remount/removed/disabled callers receive none; a new explicit focus/activation remains valid. No extra abstraction/token.
consumer_fix: Use existing DialogContent::is_open() instead of a parallel cached boolean.

gpu.reference: Explicit fresh-focus reconstruction of earlier invalid outcome; not a pre-fix GPU executable.

native.input: actual AppKit menu commands exercising public lifecycle and actual AXPress button reopening
